steps.name: Install the reviewed browser tools in an unprivileged job
steps.run:
python3 website/toolchain/prepare.py
npm ci --prefix website/toolchain --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
node website/scripts/check-package-manager.mjs
node website/toolchain/node_modules/npm/bin/npm-cli.js ci --prefix website --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
node website/node_modules/playwright/cli.js install-deps chromium
node website/scripts/site.mjs browser-install
